breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The agent repeated the original error by including 'Set viscosity to 0 everywhere for inviscid flame' in the generated specification. While it also mentions using the Sutherland transport model, it did not remove or correct the zero-viscosity directive. The ground truth explicitly states viscosity should NOT be set to 0 because a diffusion flame requires viscous/diffusive transport.
